Record with Binance Agentic Wallet

Enter your public Agentic Wallet address, paste the prompt into Binance AI Pro, then return with your transaction hash. The receipt sends 0 BNB plus network gas.

Before preparing a prompt, sign in to your Agentic Wallet in Binance AI Pro and check that Developer Mode is active in the Binance App. Prepare a fresh prompt if the five-minute snapshot expires.

Open Binance AI Pro

Keep this tab open. Paste the prompt into your signed-in Binance AI Pro chat. Review the exact call and its fees. Continue only if the preview is clean and requires confirmation in the Binance App.

A minimal proof path

Signal, not ceremony.

VeriAbstain turns a live integrity observation into a compact public receipt while keeping the underlying evidence off-chain.

CHECK

Observe finalized state

Read the deployed runtime and registry configuration at one finalized BNB Chain block.

BIND

Prove Agent ID

The contract checks your current Agent ID balance again during the write. No allowlist or admin approval.

RECORD

Commit only digests

Store two SHA-256 content commitments. Private evidence and assessment details stay with you.

Deliberately constrained

Built to prove less,
more honestly.

A receipt proves that an eligible address recorded two digests. It does not prove the underlying claim is true, grant execution permission, or authorize spending.

NOCustody

The contract cannot hold or transfer your assets.

NOAdmin key

No owner, pause, upgrade, or privileged mutation path.

NOPrivate uploads

The interface hashes structured observations locally.

YESExplicit review

Your wallet shows the destination, gas, and zero native value.

Evidence establishes facts. It never grants permission.
